facts.fact: AidData records China Eximbank and Niger signed an RMB 623.7 million concessional loan on 2 January 2014 for the National Backbone Fiber Optic Cable Network; construction officially began 15 June 2015.
facts.system: National Backbone Fiber Optic Cable Network and Communication Service Project

facts.fact: AidData says over 2,275 km of fibre was installed on three sections (Niamey-Tillabery, Zinder-Diffa, Agadez-Tahoua), construction ended in Q1 2017 and the project was completed and handed over to local authorities; it does not use the word lit or give a date of traffic.
